summary: Created "Fleet Internal CA" root CA on node1 (openssl-based CA in /root/fleet-ca), issued a server certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2,IP:10.100.107.11), configured nginx on node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that certificate, and installed the CA as a trusted system CA on both node1 and node2 via update-ca-certificates. Verified TLS trust and connectivity both locally on node2 and cross-node from node1. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes, proving changed boot_id and full post-restart recovery of CA files, trust store, nginx service, and HTTPS reachability.
actions_performed: Installed openssl on node1 and openssl+nginx+ca-certificates on node2
Created CA directory structure and generated 4096-bit CA key + self-signed root cert 'Fleet Internal CA' (10yr validity) on node1
Generated node2 key/CSR with SAN (DNS:node2, IP:10.100.107.11) and signed it with the Fleet Internal CA (825-day validity)
Transferred CA cert, node2 cert, and node2 key to node2 via base64 through direct per-node exec (SSH root login was blocked by locked root account on node2)
Configured nginx server block on node2 listening on 8443 with ssl_certificate/ssl_certificate_key, enabled nginx in default runlevel, started service
Verified HTTPS locally on node2 and cross-node from node1 using curl --cacert against the CA, confirming SAN match and successful chain verification
Installed CA cert into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and ran update-ca-certificates on both node1 and node2; confirmed hash symlink bd89aeae.0 and openssl verify success on both nodes
Captured baseline boot_id and health evidence for both nodes

Restarted node1 via 'reboot' (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and full recovery of CA files, trust store, and cross-node HTTPS verification
Restarted node2 via 'reboot', polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and full recovery of nginx service, CA trust store, and HTTPS reachability from both node2 and node1
